MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #10
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

2. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 18
   C. 7
   D. 36

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

4. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 2

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)

   B. 22
   C. 16
   D. 55

   D. 19

   A. 1

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.6
   B. 31.7
   C. 31

16. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 10

   C. 81
   D. 40.5

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
